'''Sunberries''' were a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] produced by the [[Sunberry tree/Legends|Sunberry tree]] on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was one of the many fruits that [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] ate. These berries were large and round, with an orange color, and grew on bushes. An Ewok who did not eat enough sunberries would become very sick.<ref name="The Haunted Village book" /> [[Sunberry pie]] was made from sunberries.<ref name="Horville's Hut of Horrors">{{Ewoks|Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)}}</ref>
